title: Lesser-known foreign layers: Tbilisi, South Korea, Maldives tokens, Vietnam trademarks
summary: All five leads are real and documented. The South Korean 'aggregator' lead is NYT-reported: Base Group paid Trump's company $2M in 2025 while its subsidiary Korea Aluminium fought a Commerce circumvention case, and Eric Trump visited the Hanam golf site in Feb 2026, before the payment became public. New layer: the Trump family's World Liberty Financial now runs the Maldives resort token financing as an accredited-only private placement, so the family is on both sides of that project. No favourable US decision was found for any counterparty: the Korea case moved against the firm, Ivanishvili's sanctions remain, and Vietnam received a new 12.5% Section 301 duty.

sub_claims.statement: Base Group (South Korea), parent of Korea Aluminium, paid Trump's company a $2M 'nonrefundable development fee' in 2025 while Korea Aluminium contested a Commerce circumvention case.
sub_claims.finding: DOCUMENTED (financial disclosure reported by the NYT 14 Jul 2026; confirmed by both companies; senators' letters). The fee was tied to an Aug 2025 letter of intent for golf-course management. Korea Aluminium was among six Korean firms in Commerce's aluminium foil circumvention inquiry (prelim Mar 2023, countrywide final affirmative 27 Nov 2023). Korean press citing the NYT reports a 13 Jul 2026 preliminary Commerce ruling that could raise its foil rate about fourfold to 105.8% (matching the China-wide margin; our reading). No final ruling was found as of Nov 2026. The NYT found no evidence of intervention by Trump or his family. This shows a payment from a party with an open US trade case; it does not show any favourable decision, and the only decision found went against the company.

sub_claims.statement: Senators opened inquiries: Warren/Blumenthal/Andy Kim to Base Group chairman Kim Sung-jip, Wyden to Commerce Secretary Lutnick.
sub_claims.finding: DOCUMENTED. The 6 Aug 2026 letter asked Kim Sung-jip for documents by 21 Aug and cited the federal bribery statute. Wyden asked Lutnick whether Commerce officials knew of the payment before the disclosure became public, and asked about the administration's relationship with Base Group. No public responses were found.

sub_claims.statement: The payment relates to Trump International Golf Club Korea in Hanam; Eric Trump visited the site on 11 Feb 2026.
sub_claims.finding: Project DOCUMENTED (Trump Organization and Base Group announcement, 13 Aug 2026, Hakam-dong, Hanam, Gyeonggi; first Trump golf project in Northeast Asia; Eric Trump quoted). The 11 Feb 2026 site visit with Base chairman Kim and Hanam Mayor Lee Hyun-jae is SINGLE-SOURCE (Korean business press, via search). The visit came five months before the payment became public. No Korean land-use or permit records were found.

sub_claims.statement: Trump Tower Tbilisi sits on land linked to the family of US-sanctioned Bidzina Ivanishvili, with partners close to his party.
sub_claims.finding: DOCUMENTED. Registry records cited by the Guardian and BM.ge show the former hippodrome still registered to the International Charity Fund Cartu, about 35% owned by Uta Ivanishvili via Cartu Group JSC. A 2023 agreement sells it to Central Park Avenue LLC (linked to INVIA/Wissol and Biograpi Living), and the transfer is incomplete. The WSJ (13 Sep 2026, via JAMnews) says developers bought it from the family fund in 2023. Archi Group chairman Ilia Tsulaia is a former Georgian Dream MP (Daily Beast); co-founder Meni Benish is Georgia's honorary consul in Israel (Ynet); the Sapir Organization is co-developer. Announced 19 Apr 2026; launched 15 Sep 2026 with PM Kobakhidze present ($2B, 62 storeys/282 m); Eric Trump appeared by video. Treasury sanctioned Ivanishvili on 27 Dec 2024 and no delisting was found. Denials: Ivanishvili's lawyer says most of the land was donated for a park; Biograpi Living says it is not a participant.

sub_claims.statement: US Georgia policy since the tower deal: a 'reset' in talks, the MEGOBARI sanctions bill stalled in the Senate, and no concrete US concession.
sub_claims.finding: Each event DOCUMENTED; any link to the tower INFERRED. A State Department delegation visited Tbilisi on 25-29 May 2026 and said the administration was ready for a 'constructive, forward-looking relationship'. The MEGOBARI Act passed the House 349-42 (6 May 2025) and has stalled in the Senate. OC Media opinion (SINGLE-SOURCE) says Sen. Mullin is blocking unanimous consent. Reuters reported that GOP donor Steve Nicandros (Frontera/TXN Energy) lobbied against the bill. No sanctions relief or restored strategic partnership was found, and bne IntelliNews (Jun 2026) says the reset 'keeps failing to arrive'. Commentators (Veridica, Jamestown) read the tower as Georgian Dream courting Trump; that is analysis, not evidence.

sub_claims.statement: Dar Global's tokenised Trump Maldives resort was marketed to US retail investors and discussed with the SEC.
sub_claims.finding: DOCUMENTED, with a correction. In Nov 2025 (Reuters via The Block) Dar Global planned to sell up to 70% of the ~$300M project as tokens to US retail investors and was in talks with the SEC. On 18 Feb 2026 the plan was restructured: World Liberty Financial, with Securitize and DarGlobal, would tokenise loan revenue interests (not equity) as an unregistered Reg D 506(c) placement for verified accredited investors plus Reg S offshore. That needs no SEC approval and excludes retail buyers. New layer: the family earns licence fees from Dar Global (C31) and holds a large stake in WLF, which runs the financing tokens, so it is on both sides of the project. The Trump Organization says it does not issue or promote the tokens. No amount raised was found. Completion is now about 2030.

sub_claims.statement: The Trump company filed new trademark applications in Vietnam after the tariff deal.
sub_claims.finding: DOCUMENTED (CREW, from international trademark databases). DTTM Operations LLC filed five applications on 27 Nov 2025 (e.g. Trump International Hung Yen, Trump Residences Vietnam, Trump International Golf Club Vietnam), published about two months later. They came about five months after the 2 Jul 2025 tariff announcement and a month after the 26 Oct 2025 framework. Granting them is a Vietnamese government decision (an emoluments question); grant status was not found.

sub_claims.statement: Farmers at Hung Yen were displaced with low compensation, and the corresponding US decisions on Vietnam since.
sub_claims.finding: DOCUMENTED. Reuters (Aug 2025) reported offers of about $12/m2 plus rice, paid by the state but funded by developers. SCMP reported petitions for double compensation. Bloomberg (Jun 2026) reported enforcement against holdouts from 26 Jun 2026. Grave exhumations are reported by trade press (single-source). The Trump Organization says it is not responsible for compensation. US side: the trade agreement is still unsigned (Hanoi sent final text in Oct 2026), and an additional 12.5% Section 301 duty on Vietnamese goods took effect on 24 Jul 2026 (single-source: VnEconomy). This cuts against a special-favour reading.

corrections: The $2M South Korean payment is not just an unverified aggregator claim. It comes from Trump's 2026 financial disclosure (NYT, 14 Jul 2026) and is confirmed by Base Group and the Trump Organization.
The Maldives tokens were not cleared by the SEC for US retail buyers. The Feb 2026 structure is an unregistered Reg D 506(c)/Reg S placement for accredited investors, issued with WLF and Securitize.
Trump Tower Tbilisi is 62 storeys/282 m in launch materials, not 70 storeys. The Cartu land transfer was not complete as of mid-2026.
The ~105.8% Korea Aluminium rate is a reported preliminary rate (matching the China-wide margin), not a final determination.
denials_and_context: The Trump Organization and Base Group say the $2M was a standard fee under an Aug 2025 golf LOI. Base Group denies trade violations. The NYT found no evidence of family intervention.

The White House says neither the president nor his family engages in conflicts of interest. The Trump Organization describes itself as only a licensor in Tbilisi and the Maldives and says it does not issue or promote the tokens.
Ivanishvili's lawyer says most of the family's racecourse land was donated to the state for a park. Biograpi Living says it is not a participant.
Georgia's ambassador says the government has no US lobbying affiliations.

Inferred only (no source asserts): the timing of the State Department reset visit against the Guardian land story; the Aug 2025 LOI against the US-Korea tariff deal and summit; WLF tokenisation against the SEC's tokenisation-friendly stance.
